measured, written into twenty documents and a slide deck, and then the code
moved without them. 'how' is the important column — a number nobody can
reproduce is an assertion, not a measurement.

how: Count through pg_depend, NEVER bare information_schema.
CREATE EXTENSION postgis installs spatial_ref_sys into public, which
inflated tables, primary keys, indexes and unique indexes by exactly one
each. information_schema.check_constraints emits one row per NOT NULL
column, which is how '433 check constraints' was published when there are 5.
TABLES, PRIMARY KEYS, FOREIGN KEYS, CHECK CONSTRAINTS — filter on the
TABLE's oid, which is the row pg_depend actually records as extension-owned:
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class c
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace AND n.nspname = 'public'
LEFT JOIN pg_depend d ON d.objid = c.oid AND d.deptype = 'e'
WHERE c.relkind = 'r' AND d.objid IS NULL;
INDEXES AND UNIQUE INDEXES — the same filter on the INDEX's own oid
matches nothing and silently leaves spatial_ref_sys_pkey in, giving 139
and 85. pg_depend records extension membership for the TABLE only; an
index depends on its table, not on the extension. Filter on indrelid:
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class c
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace AND n.nspname = 'public'
JOIN pg_index i ON i.indexrelid = c.oid
LEFT JOIN pg_depend d ON d.objid = i.indrelid
AND d.classid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND d.deptype = 'e'
WHERE c.relkind = 'i' AND d.objid IS NULL;        -- add i.indisunique for unique
Count app.get/post/patch/put/delete call sites across apps/api/src:
34 in server.ts + 17 in raksha.ts + 4 in routes/auth.ts
+ 2 in routes/email-auth.ts + 6 in routes/emergency.ts
+ 1 in routes/telecom.ts + 3 in routes/mechanic.ts + 3 in routes/payments.ts + 4 in routes/geo.ts + 1 in routes/impact.ts.
grep -rnE 'app[.](get|post|put|patch|delete)[(]' apps/api/src | wc -l
71 of the 74 are under /v1. The other three are infrastructure, all in
server.ts: GET /tiles/:z/:x/:file, GET /basemap/:z/:x/:file and GET /health.
The SPLIT moves whenever a route group is lifted out of server.ts — it was
'49 in server.ts + 15 in raksha.ts' until auth and emergency came out, then
'41 + 15 + 3 + 5' until telecom, mechanic and payments came out too. Each
time the total was unchanged and only the split moved, so a stale split can
sit behind a correct total for months. Re-derive it; never assume it.
It was still published as 65 after routes/email-auth.ts added two routes:
the other half of the same failure, a new file nobody added to the sum.
